result.target_topic: Management's Cybersecurity Program Leadership and Strategy
result.target_summary: The Cybersecurity Program is managed by the CIO and CISO, with strategy set by the CISO and overseen by the Head of NFR CTIS, utilizing risk assessments and threat intelligence. These senior officers have extensive experience, with the CIO having over 30 years, the CISO over 25 years, and the Head of NFR CTIS over 20 years in relevant fields.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: This 2024 disclosure covers the Cybersecurity Program governance (CIO/CISO roles), which is a specific operational risk topic. The 2023 disclosures (D227, D228) cover the broader Head of Non-Financial Risk role, which includes cybersecurity as a sub-component, but the specific 2024 disclosure focusing on the CIO/CISO structure and cybersecurity program management does not have a dedicated single counterpart in 2023. D227/D228 are matched to D219 which covers the Head of NFR role generally. D348 is a distinct, detailed cybersecurity governance disclosure.

comparisons.peer_topic: CISO Role, Expertise, and Team Structure
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi's CISO, who reports to the Head of Technology and Business Enablement, manages material cybersecurity risks and is supported by a team of approximately 3,400 individuals including subject matter experts in various security domains.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and C disclose the specific leadership structure and expertise of their Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). MS states its CISO has over 25 years of experience leading cybersecurity teams at financial institutions, while C notes its CISO has 'decades of experience' in managing cybersecurity risks from prior roles at major financial and government institutions. Both firms emphasize the senior leadership's deep industry tenure.

sentences.text: The CISO has over 25 years of experience leading cybersecurity teams at financial institutions, including in the areas of IT strategy, risk management and information security.

Citi's CISO has decades of experience in managing cybersecurity risks from prior roles as Deutsche Bank's Chief Security Officer, the Chief Information Officer for the Central Intelligence Agency and the Chief Information Officer for the U.S. Intelligence Community.

comparisons.peer_topic: Head of Technology and Business Enablement Role and Background
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi's Head of Technology and Business Enablement, who reports directly to the CEO, holds overall responsibility for first-line defense cyber and information security programs and has over 30 years of experience in the financial services industry.
comparisons.comparison: MS and C both identify senior executives with extensive tenure who oversee or set cybersecurity strategy. MS identifies the Head of NFR CTIS as overseeing strategy and notes they have over 20 years of experience, while C identifies the Head of Technology and Business Enablement as having overall responsibility for first-line defense programs and possessing over 30 years of experience in financial services.

sentences.text: The Head of NFR CTIS has over 20 years of experience in technology, security and compliance roles, including experience in government security agencies.

Citi's Head of Technology and Business Enablement, who reports directly to Citi's CEO, has overall responsibility for Citi's first line of defense cyber and information security and technology programs.
Citi's Head of Technology and Business Enablement has over 30 years of experience in the financial services industry.

comparisons.peer_topic: CISO responsibilities and Technology Risk team functions
comparisons.peer_summary: The CISO manages and implements the Cybersecurity Program, reporting directly to the CIO. The CISO oversees the Technology Risk team, which assesses and manages material cybersecurity risks, sets control requirements, assesses adherence, and oversees incident detection and response. CISO and Technology Risk personnel have substantial expertise in information security and cybersecurity risk management.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and GS describe the CISO's role in managing the cybersecurity program and highlight the substantial expertise of the management team. MS states the CISO sets strategy with extensive experience, while GS states the CISO manages and implements the Cybersecurity Program and has substantial relevant expertise in information security and cybersecurity risk management.

sentences.text: Our Cybersecurity Program is operated and maintained by management, including the Chief Information Officer of Cyber, Data, Risk and Resilience ("CIO") and the Chief Information Security Officer ("CISO").
The members of management that lead our Cybersecurity Program and strategy have extensive experience in technology, cybersecurity and information security.
Our CISO is responsible for managing and implementing the Cybersecurity Program and reports directly to our chief information officer.

Our CISO, senior management within Technology Risk and Operational Risk, as well as management personnel overseeing the Cybersecurity Program, all have substantial relevant expertise in the areas of information security and cybersecurity risk management.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Board, including its Risk Committee and Technology Risk Subcommittee, oversees risk management policies and practices, including cybersecurity risks. The CRO, CIO, and CTO periodically brief the Board on operational and technology risks, while the CISO provides regular briefings on the Cybersecurity Program, emerging threats, mitigation strategies, and regulatory engagements. Directors maintain ongoing dialogue with the CISO and other executives on these topics.
comparisons.comparison: While MS focuses on operational management and strategy set by specific officers (CISO, Head of NFR CTIS), GS provides a more detailed disclosure on Board-level oversight, noting that the Board receives regular briefings from the CISO on the status of the Cybersecurity Program and emerging threats. MS does not explicitly mention Board briefings in the provided text, focusing instead on the internal leadership structure.

sentences.text: Our Cybersecurity Program strategy, which is set by the CISO and overseen by the Head of Cyber, Technology, and Information Security Non-Financial Risk ("Head of NFR CTIS"), is informed by various risk and control assessments, control testing, external assessments, threat intelligence, and public and private information sharing.

The Board also receives regular briefings from our CISO on a range of cybersecurity-related topics, including the status of our Cybersecurity Program, emerging cybersecurity threats, mitigation strategies and related regulatory engagements.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Global CISO reports to the Global CIO, leads the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization, and possesses relevant expertise in cybersecurity and IT risk management.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPM disclose that their respective CISOs lead the cybersecurity function and possess significant relevant experience. MS highlights the CISO's 25+ years of experience leading teams at financial institutions, while JPM states the Global CISO leads the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization and has relevant expertise and experience in cybersecurity and IT risk management.

sentences.text: The CISO has over 25 years of experience leading cybersecurity teams at financial institutions, including in the areas of IT strategy, risk management and information security.

The CISO leads the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization, which is responsible for identifying technology and cybersecurity risks and for implementing and maintaining controls to manage cybersecurity threats.

The CISO and the members of senior management within Global Technology and the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organizations all have relevant expertise and experience in cybersecurity and information technology risk management, including relevant experience at the Firm, at other financial services companies or in other highly-regulated industries.
